_readme: Reference examples for the embedding classifier (SPEC 8.3). These are embedded once at startup and held in memory; an incoming prompt is compared against all of them and the k nearest vote on tier. This is TRAINING data, not a test set -- measuring accuracy on it would measure memorisation. Held-out evaluation lives in holdout.json.
_note: Phrasings are deliberately varied within each tier. The point of the embedding classifier is to generalise beyond the keyword list in signals.py, so examples that share meaning but not vocabulary are the useful ones.
